top_signals.title: Stocks, Bonds Rise as Weak Jobs Curb Fed-Hike Bets: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A sharp slowdown in the US jobs market drove stocks higher as bond yields fell on speculation the Federal Reserve won’t be forced to raise interest rates any time soon.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: KKR, Blackstone Are Among Suitors for Windshield Repairer Cary
top_signals.summary: KKR & Co., Blackstone Inc. and Warburg Pincus are considering bids for windshield-repair company Cary, according to people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
